author: jracer15
body:
[Note] These are only the beginning look of the map, so before you consider whats wrong with it, just know it's only the concept basically, I'm fine with suggestion for ideas to a space themed walls!
I've now been working on a new walls map called Gravity!  It comes with a story!  Jump boost and slowness added to the map to feel gravity like!  This map features a new game play style feel and a new creative landscape!

http://imgur.com/a/gBNaS#0
